fsm_states_master.name: M_IDLE
fsm_states_master.description: Bus released (HIGH via pull-up); master waits for next transaction trigger.

fsm_states_master.name: M_RESET
fsm_states_master.description: Master drives DQ LOW for ≥ 480 µs (standard speed) to issue a Reset Pulse.

fsm_states_master.name: M_PRESENCE_WAIT
fsm_states_master.description: Master releases DQ; samples for Presence Pulse within tPDH + tPDL window (15-240 µs after release).

fsm_states_master.name: M_ROM_CMD
fsm_states_master.description: Master transmits 1-byte ROM command (Read ROM 0x33, Match ROM 0x55, Skip ROM 0xCC, Search ROM 0xF0, Alarm Search 0xEC, Resume 0x69, Overdrive Skip 0xA5, Overdrive Match 0x3C).

fsm_states_master.name: M_ADDRESS
fsm_states_master.description: If ROM command is Match ROM or Overdrive Match: master transmits the 64-bit ROM ID of the targeted slave.

fsm_states_master.name: M_FUNC_CMD
fsm_states_master.description: Master transmits 1-byte device-specific Function Command (e.g. 0x44 Convert T for DS18B20).

fsm_states_master.name: M_DATA_XFER
fsm_states_master.description: Master generates Write or Read time slots; data flows MSB-first (or LSB-first depending on device convention) byte by byte.

fsm_states_master.name: M_SEARCH
fsm_states_master.description: During Search ROM, master transmits binary-tree query: at each ROM-ID bit position, master reads bit (all responding slaves drive their bit) then reads its complement (slaves drive complement); master then writes the chosen path bit to filter slaves not matching that path.

fsm_states_slave.name: S_RESET_WAIT
fsm_states_slave.description: Slave samples DQ LOW for ≥ tRSTL_MIN; transitions to S_PRESENCE on master release.

fsm_states_slave.name: S_PRESENCE
fsm_states_slave.description: After tPDH (15-60 µs), slave drives DQ LOW for tPDL (60-240 µs) — the Presence Pulse.

fsm_states_slave.name: S_ROM_LISTEN
fsm_states_slave.description: Slave samples 8-bit ROM command transmitted by master.

fsm_states_slave.name: S_ROM_MATCH_CHECK
fsm_states_slave.description: If Match ROM (0x55) or Overdrive Match (0x3C): slave compares each transmitted ROM-ID bit against its own; mismatch → drop out and wait for next Reset.

fsm_states_slave.name: S_SEARCH_RESPOND
fsm_states_slave.description: During Search ROM (0xF0): slave drives its current ROM-ID bit (Read slot 1), then drives the complement (Read slot 2); on master's Write slot, if master's bit doesn't match slave's bit, slave drops out.

fsm_states_slave.name: S_FUNC_LISTEN
fsm_states_slave.description: Slave executes device-specific Function Command (read scratchpad, write scratchpad, convert temperature, etc.).

fsm_states_slave.name: S_DATA_XFER
fsm_states_slave.description: Slave participates in Write/Read time slots until next Reset Pulse aborts the transaction.

fsm_hints_master.trigger: Application initiates a Reset Pulse by pulling DQ LOW for ≥ 480 µs.
fsm_hints_master.rule: Always Reset before any new transaction; ROM command must be issued first; Match/Search ROM must be followed by 64-bit ROM ID; Function Command is device-specific.
fsm_hints_master.abort: Master issues new Reset Pulse to abort any in-progress transaction — slaves resync at next Presence Pulse.

fsm_hints_slave.trigger: Slave detects DQ LOW for ≥ tRSTL_MIN (≥ 480 µs std / ≥ 48 µs overdrive).
fsm_hints_slave.rule: Respond with Presence Pulse 15-60 µs after master release; then participate in ROM-command address resolution; drop out on first ROM-ID mismatch; resume only on next Reset.
fsm_hints_slave.abort: Any DQ LOW for ≥ tRSTL_MIN aborts and re-arms the slave; slave returns to S_PRESENCE.

anti_deadlock_rule: Wired-AND single line: any slave or master can pull LOW. Master always initiates and times the protocol; slaves never spontaneously transmit (except the Presence Pulse, which is a deterministic response to Reset). Bus-stuck-LOW indicates a wiring fault or a failed slave; master must restart by power-cycling or issuing Reset.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On power-on, master leaves DQ released (HIGH via pull-up); waits for application to issue Reset Pulse. Slaves power up and become ready when their on-chip energy storage capacitor charges via parasitic power; first Reset Pulse establishes synchronization.

default_ready_state_recommendation.DQ_idle: HIGH (released; pulled to VDD by Rp). Both master and slave outputs are released.
default_ready_state_recommendation.slave_internal_state: Awaiting Reset Pulse; no transaction in progress.

speed_modes.name: Standard speed
speed_modes.description: tRSTL ≥ 480 µs; time-slot 60 µs minimum (typically 60-120 µs); bit rate ~16 kbit/s.

speed_modes.name: Overdrive speed
speed_modes.description: tRSTL ≥ 48 µs (8× faster); time-slot ~7.5 µs; bit rate ~125 kbit/s. Only suitable for short connections.

timing_dependency_rule: All time-slot timings are master-driven. Master pulls DQ LOW to start each slot (1-15 µs LOW for Write-1/Read; ≥ 60 µs LOW for Write-0). Slave samples its expected behavior on the master's falling edge; master samples slave's response ~15 µs after its own falling edge (Read slot). Recovery time ≥ 1 µs between slots.
